questions.stem: What is the correct half-equation for the reaction at the cathode during the electrolysis of molten sodium chloride?
questions.explanation: At the cathode (negative electrode), sodium ions (Na⁺) gain electrons to form sodium metal: Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na. This is reduction (gain of electrons). The chloride ions are discharged at the anode instead: 2Cl⁻ → Cl₂ + 2e⁻.
